[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tyneir Renz]]'s '''son''' was a victim of a [[Death/Legends|massacre]] carried out during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]<ref name="Idol Intentions" />&mdash;which had been [[Declaration of a New Order|founded]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Inaugural Edition">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}} places the the [[Declaration of a New Order]] on 16:5:241 on the [[Great ReSynchronization]] calendar, which corresponds with [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref>&mdash;at their [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] [[Jiaan]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;an act that was done in retaliation for Renz's survival of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The son's [[Tyneir Renz's wife|mother]] also perished in the massacre, though their father was able to save their sister, [[Padija Anjeri]].<ref name="Idol Intentions" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyneir Renz's son was mentioned in Tyneir Renz's character statistics block in "[[Idol Intentions]]," a short story by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] in the [[February]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|twelfth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Idol Intentions" />
